decisions.reason: The rendered-colors clause does not change the existing requirement to match the beige reference finish; the newly specified bottom logo belongs to support-base branding.
The graphics request does not alter the base's height, cup-clearance purpose, or footprint alignment.
The source supplies concrete branding, control-styling, and lighting details without changing the existing overarching DJ-inspired visual identity or reference-rendering goal.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the rendered buttons, Deck 1 and Deck 2 labels, and back-panel design and font; the bottom-logo clause adds no control-styling change.
Reproducing the rendered colors is already represented by the current color-scheme reference and does not replace or remove the established beige and green color attributes.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring lighting around the power button; the bottom-logo clause creates no additional lighting change.
The requested graphics and typography do not change enclosure size, thickness, or accepted physical form.
The source does not discuss the spout's appearance, material, fabrication, or dispensing design.
External colors, labels, lighting, and branding do not affect the required materials for food-contact components.
The logo along the bottom is a separate support-base branding element and does not change the existing Elena's Chai Whisk placard text, position, orientation, or two-sided display.
The visual-design request has no effect on liquid-path access, sanitation, or prevention of trapped liquid.
Lighting around the power button changes its visual treatment, not the requirement for a dedicated user-operated power control.
